comment: * An interface that can be implemented by Views to provide scroll related APIs.

methods.name: int computeHorizontalScrollRange()
methods.comment:
*

Compute the horizontal range that the horizontal scrollbar * represents.

* *

The range is expressed in arbitrary units that must be the same as the * units used by {@link #computeHorizontalScrollExtent()} and * {@link #computeHorizontalScrollOffset()}.

* *

The default range is the drawing width of this view.

* * @return the total horizontal range represented by the horizontal * scrollbar * * @see #computeHorizontalScrollExtent() * @see #computeHorizontalScrollOffset()

methods.name: int computeHorizontalScrollOffset()
methods.comment:
*

Compute the horizontal offset of the horizontal scrollbar's thumb * within the horizontal range. This value is used to compute the position * of the thumb within the scrollbar's track.

* *

The range is expressed in arbitrary units that must be the same as the * units used by {@link #computeHorizontalScrollRange()} and * {@link #computeHorizontalScrollExtent()}.

* *

The default offset is the scroll offset of this view.

* * @return the horizontal offset of the scrollbar's thumb * * @see #computeHorizontalScrollRange() * @see #computeHorizontalScrollExtent()

methods.name: int computeHorizontalScrollExtent()
methods.comment:
*

Compute the horizontal extent of the horizontal scrollbar's thumb * within the horizontal range. This value is used to compute the length * of the thumb within the scrollbar's track.

* *

The range is expressed in arbitrary units that must be the same as the * units used by {@link #computeHorizontalScrollRange()} and * {@link #computeHorizontalScrollOffset()}.

* *

The default extent is the drawing width of this view.

* * @return the horizontal extent of the scrollbar's thumb * * @see #computeHorizontalScrollRange() * @see #computeHorizontalScrollOffset()

methods.name: int computeVerticalScrollRange()
methods.comment:
*

Compute the vertical range that the vertical scrollbar represents.

* *

The range is expressed in arbitrary units that must be the same as the * units used by {@link #computeVerticalScrollExtent()} and * {@link #computeVerticalScrollOffset()}.

* * @return the total vertical range represented by the vertical scrollbar * *

The default range is the drawing height of this view.

* * @see #computeVerticalScrollExtent() * @see #computeVerticalScrollOffset()

methods.name: int computeVerticalScrollOffset()
methods.comment:
*

Compute the vertical offset of the vertical scrollbar's thumb * within the horizontal range. This value is used to compute the position * of the thumb within the scrollbar's track.

* *

The range is expressed in arbitrary units that must be the same as the * units used by {@link #computeVerticalScrollRange()} and * {@link #computeVerticalScrollExtent()}.

* *

The default offset is the scroll offset of this view.

* * @return the vertical offset of the scrollbar's thumb * * @see #computeVerticalScrollRange() * @see #computeVerticalScrollExtent()

methods.name: int computeVerticalScrollExtent()
methods.comment:
*

Compute the vertical extent of the vertical scrollbar's thumb * within the vertical range. This value is used to compute the length * of the thumb within the scrollbar's track.

* *

The range is expressed in arbitrary units that must be the same as the * units used by {@link #computeVerticalScrollRange()} and * {@link #computeVerticalScrollOffset()}.

* *

The default extent is the drawing height of this view.

* * @return the vertical extent of the scrollbar's thumb * * @see #computeVerticalScrollRange() * @see #computeVerticalScrollOffset()
